name: Order To An AI Reader That Acts Against Its User
description: Text on a page, in a file, in an API response or in tool output that is written to an AI reader and orders that reader to act on the person it works for. It names the reader, as in a note to AI assistants, in a duty stated about AI agents, or by a bare address such as AI or Agent, and near that name orders it to buy, pay, use a saved card, empty or cancel the order, send the person's data or post what the order holds in public, change a delivery or billing address, switch off a protection, or act without telling the person or against a limit the person set. A sentence that forbids the same act, or asks the person first, is not matched.
